Spring AI

Spring AI provides the following features:

  • Portable API support across AI providers for Chat, text-to-image, and Embedding models.
  • Vector Store API with a portable SQL-like metadata filter API.
  • Tool Calling supports flexible workflows.
    • Client-side tool execution.
    • Server-side tools that the model can invoke safely.
